name: LTX-2.3 22B Distilled (dynamic rank)
means: Distillation for LTX-2.3 video - lets a clip render on a short sigma schedule instead of the full one.
note: base_model READ FROM THE HEADER: model_version = '2.3.0'. One of only two files in this set that state an LTX version; the other three LTX LoRAs are inferred by structural match to this one. | THE STRENGTH FIELD CONTRADICTS THE REPO AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Every LTX workflow in the studio (11, 12, 17, 18, 20) wires this at 0.5, while the repo's own LORAS.md states that accelerators must run at exactly 1.0. Two sources of truth, no render to settle them. The card records the value that is ACTUALLY IN THE GRAPHS, because that is the value every existing LTX clip was made with - but strength_range goes to 1.0 because the doc may well be right and nobody has looked. This is the single most likely wrong number in this library. | DYNAMIC RANK, genuinely: ss_network_dim and ss_network_alpha are both the literal string 'Dynamic', ss_training_comment says 'Dynamic resize with sv_fro: 0.9 from 384', and the per-layer rank really does vary from 3 to 384 - the filename's 'avg_rank_111' is honest. lora_scan.py reports the MODAL rank with a `~` for this reason; one number would be a lie. alpha == rank in every layer, so scale is 1.0 throughout. | 4979 tensors across diffusion_model.transformer_blocks.0..47 plus 8 adaln_single families (adaln, audio_adaln, audio_prompt_adaln, prompt_adaln, and four av_ca_* cross-attention gates) - the audio families are what make LTX-2.3 structurally unmistakable. | Carries the full 21,468-character LTX-2 Community License (dated January 5, 2026) in its metadata. Anything redistributing this file inherits that.
